extended:
**The holonomy braiding for U_xi(sl2) in terms of geometric quantum dilogarithms**

*CALVIN MCPHAIL-SNYDER AND NICOLAI RESHETIKHIN*

41 pp, 28 sections.

**Abstract.** We derive an explicit formula for the holonomy R-matrix of quantum sl2 at a root of unity. We show it factorizes into a product of four quantum dilogarithms and satisfies a holonomy Yang-Baxter equation. This factorization extends previously known results and we collect many existing results needed for our computation.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Quantum sl2 and Weyl algebras; 2.1 The braiding for quantum sl2; 2.2 The braiding for Uq(sl2); 2.3 Representation into the Weyl algebra; 3 Specialization to a root of unity; 3.1 Central subalgebras at roots of unity; 3.2 Uξ-modules.; 3.3 The braiding on characters; 3.4 The homomorphism from Uq to the Weyl algeb; 3.5 Braiding of Uξ-modules.; 3.6 Wξ-modules; 4 The R-matrix in the Fourier dual basis; 4.1 Recursions for the R-matrix coefficients; 4.2 The normalized R-matrix; 4.3 Factorization of the R-matrix; 4.4 The holonomy Yang-Baxter equation
